svg.title: cross-port-kill: pk port 3000
svg.desc: A terminal uses plain words. pk port 3000 shows node holding port 3000 and ends with 'To free it: pk 3000'. pk kill 3000 frees it. pk what is on 8080 shows the Docker container api and how to free it; a question only ever looks. pk kil 5173 is a typo and pk answers: Unknown word 'kil'. Did you mean 'kill'?

g.text: PORT PROCESS PID/ID USER ACCESS COMMAND
